newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish June consumer confidence up to 15.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Finnish June consumer confidence up to 15.9 pct.

text.p: The Finnish consumer confidence indicator rose in June to 15.9 points from 15.5 points in May, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Thursday.
"Half of Finns estimated in June that the country's economy had improved during the past year. As many believed it to improve also in the year ahead," SF said.

Consumer confidence is measured as the average of estimates on five variables: personal finances in the past year and coming year, the Finnish economy in the past and the coming year, and how advantageous it is to buy durable goods. @
The consumer confidence indicator was 15.5 points in May, 17.1 points in April, 15.6 points in March and 15.9 points in February and 15.5 points in January.
